gate_results.gate_id: D2-006-G5: Cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL

observations: RETROSPECTIVE: this report was authored after execution as part of WP-6c. Metrics are transcribed from DEC-0002, the H-002 trial_log entry, and the H-002 experiment notebook. H-002 produced positive full-period PnL but OOS Sharpe of 0.07581376350868253, far below the 1.0 promotion threshold, with max drawdown of 120.5047%. The strategy failed 3 of 8 D2-006 gates, including Sharpe, drawdown, and 90-day concentration, and DEC-0002 archived the candidate as a baseline NO-GO. Max-drawdown and cost-drag values are under pre-WP-5b pipeline semantics; per WP-5a/WP-5b audit conclusions the overall NO-GO verdict is unaffected by later pipeline fixes.
diagnostic_findings: Simple 4h Donchian breakout trend following without additional risk or context design is not promotable under current promotion gates.
Positive total PnL was insufficient because risk-adjusted performance and drawdown durability failed.
PnL was concentrated enough to fail the 90-day contribution gate.
Long trades carried the positive net PnL while short trades were net negative, weakening the symmetric trend-following thesis.
Future Donchian or trend-following variants should be pre-registered separately with explicit risk controls and a fresh trial budget.
